I’m very sorry to bother you again! I absolutely loved the illustration you drew for me last time. It was so beautiful!

This time, I would love to commission an illustration of my OC and my friend’s OC.

The girl in black is a witch who embodies the greed within the human heart. She longs to befriend humans, but anyone who grows close to her will gradually develop darker desires and greed, eventually falling into corruption and misfortune. The closer she wishes to be to someone, the more likely she is to hurt them. Please draw her with a crown.

The girl in white is a pure being formed from people’s longing and cherished thoughts. She knows neither evil nor greed, and anyone near her can feel a gentle warmth. Please draw the shape of her long hair.

She is also the only person completely unaffected by the girl in black. Because of this, the two naturally grew close and became inseparable friends.

I would love to see their interaction and the way these two contrasting existences—darkness and purity, greed and warmth—intertwine with each other. Please feel free to interpret the composition and atmosphere in your own way!

Thank you so much!
